data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Loaded with fresh blueberries and topped with a sweet glaze, these scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch. This recipe yields 8 scones and takes about 30 minutes to prepare.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
6. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
10. Let cool slightly before serving.

Tips: For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep the scones tender. You can substitute frozen blueberries if fresh aren't available.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed

  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

notes.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe
notes.content:
Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup cold butter
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Mix dry ingredients.
3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Whisk cream, egg, and vanilla; stir into flour mixture.
5. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Pat dough into circle, cut into wedges.
7. Bake 15-18 minutes until golden.

Source: www.codedculinary.com
